text:
rebecca: Hey folks — customer org_98765 (acct_4444) says their promo credits weren’t consumed first, free-tier credits burned and now they have an unexpected invoice. Ticket INC-4927. Can someone triage? :grimacing:

billing-bot: New incident created INC-4927 by rebecca. Attach logs and steps when available.

bilal: grabbing the account logs now. do we have request_ids or sample traces?

rebecca: pasted the event stream below (sanitized):
```
event: free_credit_debit, amount: 500, org: org_98765, id: evt_aa1, ts: 2024-11-02T15:03:01Z
event: promo_credit_debit, amount: 500, org: org_98765, id: evt_ab2, ts: 2024-11-02T15:03:02Z
api_trace: req=rz-7f3a log=ingest-kafka-offset=12045 consumer=metering-worker
```
Customer claim: promo should have priority and be deducted first (per promo policy). They see UI dashboard showing promo balance still present, invoice shows overage.

alice: quick hypothesis: this looks like an ordering/race between the promo-apply lambda and the metering consumer. promo credits attach (writes promo record) but metering worker reads credit snapshot slightly before the promo write is fully visible -> free pool used first.

mateo: can you paste the SQL result for credit_events for that org? need to confirm write ordering.

rebecca: ran query for them, results: 
```
SELECT id, type, amount, created_at, meta->>'source' as src
FROM credit_events
WHERE org_id='org_98765'
ORDER BY created_at ASC;
-- evt_x1 free_credit_debit 2024-11-02T15:03:01Z src=metering
-- evt_x2 promo_credit_grant 2024-11-02T15:03:01.850Z src=promo-service
-- evt_x3 promo_credit_debit 2024-11-02T15:03:02Z src=metering
```
So promo_grant landed between the free debit and the later promo debit, but UI still shows grant as active until the later debit processed. timings are sub-second.

bilal: ok that matches racey behavior. current credits service is eventually consistent across writer nodes; metering worker reads from read-replica with ~200–500ms lag sometimes. We should not rely on read-lag for priority semantics.

alice: proposed mitigation: make metering debit use idempotent, versioned debit flow: read-and-reserve via single transactional DB operation (eg. UPDATE ... WHERE version = X RETURNING). fallback: if simultaneous writes, prefer blocking retry + re-evaluate priority.

mateo: I can push a quick patch that: (1) includes event_version on credit grants, (2) metering worker will treat grants with version>snapshot as "pending" and retry up to 3x with backoff. Will test on staging.

sam: meanwhile we should refund the customer so they aren't charged. who can perform manual adjustment? Need audit log entry.

rebecca: I requested a manual credit of 500 promo units to acct_4444 and added note to INC-4927. please confirm when posted.

billing-bot: Manual adjustment queued ADJ-7721 by rebecca.

bilal: requested offsets from Kafka for consumer group metering-worker at that time: topic=usage-events partition=3 offset_start=12040 offset_end=12050. attaching offsets to ticket.

alice: short-term config change: bump read-replica consistency for metering read path to prefer primary for 1s window when promo flag present. low-risk and will reduce occurrences while patch is tested.

mateo: pushed patch to staging branch, ran integration with synthetic events (sub-ms ordering). staging shows correct debit ordering now. planning canary to prod tonight 11:30pm UTC with 10% workers.

sam: refund posted, customer notified, invoice adjusted. INC-4927 -> resolved with manual credit + canary patch. posting postmortem checklist to ticket.

rebecca: thanks all. follow-up actions: (1) mateo deploy canary -> monitor for 24h (2) alice/infra to review read-replica lag metrics (3) billing to scan last 24h for similar anomalies and auto-open tickets.

bilal: adding automation ticket to detect orgs where promo_grant timestamp > promo_debit timestamp and invoice shows overage. will surface to SRE runbook.

rebecca: closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:
